import Architect
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum
import Mathlib.Tactic.LinearCombination

set_option warningAsError true
set_option maxHeartbeats 200000

namespace P14Bad

@[blueprint "thm:p14bad-target"]
theorem p14_target (n : ℕ) : 11 ∣ (10^n - (-1 : ℤ)^n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => norm_num
  | succ n ih =>
    rcases ih with ⟨q, hq⟩
    refine ⟨10 * q + (-1 : ℤ)^n, ?_⟩
    have factor : (10 : ℤ)^(n + 1) - (-1 : ℤ)^(n + 1) =
        10 * ((10 : ℤ)^n - (-1 : ℤ)^n) + 11 * (-1 : ℤ)^n := by
      rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]
      ring
    rw [factor, hq]
    ring

end P14Bad

#check (P14Bad.p14_target : ∀ n : ℕ, (11 : ℤ) ∣ ((10 : ℤ)^n - (-1 : ℤ)^n))
#print axioms P14Bad.p14_target
